answer.rationale: Primary region write latency is 5x target and confined to primary; regional failover (memory_b2) restored latency fast with clean traffic shift during prior degradation. Rollback is blocked by compliance on security patch. Add capacity takes too long during peak settlement. Circuit breaker risks customer writes during heavy write load. Routing read queries to replicas (memory_b5) doesn't address write path latency. Failover is the only tested intervention that addresses write path degradation without reverting the required security patch, and it can execute within the current single-intervention window during peak settlement traffic.
